refinements.frontline: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this 4x4 animation atlas. Preserve this EXACT bronze axe captain, all 16 poses, painterly style, transparent alpha background. Fix only layout: shrink each individual sprite by 25 percent WITHIN its own equal grid cell, so there is a wide fully transparent margin on ALL FOUR SIDES of every pose. Separate the final two death poses entirely. No sprites or weapons may touch other cells or the outer image border. Align feet at 85 percent of cell height. Keep 4 rows x 4 columns and genuinely transparent background. No new objects, no labels, no painted backdrop. This is a production sprite sheet: strict equal grid spacing is essential.
refinements.frostcrown: Use case: precise-object-edit. Preserve EXACT frost-crowned sword boss, armor, all 16 poses, 4x4 animation layout, transparent alpha and painterly rendering. Fix ONLY spacing and excessive FX: shrink every character and its weapon to 70% within its equal grid cell, center horizontally with feet at 85% cell height. Remove the large ice slash wave in row3 column3; show only the sword's small blue glow, no detached effects. All 16 characters and weapons must be fully separated with broad transparent gaps. No touching any neighbor or image edge. Same 4 rows x 4 columns: idle, walk, attack, death. No text, no background, no grid lines. Genuine transparent alpha PNG.
